description:
Hushfacebook v0.1.3 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release can hide the Stories tray, "Suggested for you" posts and "People you may know". It adds Hide AI-detected posts, Download any video with a save folder you name, a Material You theme and Sanitize sharing links. Links that open in your browser lose their fbclid tag, and Hushfacebook's text follows the language Facebook shows.

18 patches in all. Sponsored and suggested posts leave the news feed without a gap, and ads are gone from Stories and Reels. Facebook stops downloading ads in the background and sending ad telemetry. Links open in your own browser, stories, reels and videos can be saved, and there's an AMOLED black theme or a Material You one if you want it.

Validation: 372 runtime tests passed locally. All 106 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lint checks. All 18 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 with no manifest changes.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
